definitions.explanation: The pointed or outermost end of something.
The most advanced or modern point of development in a field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先端|せんたん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧。
examples.english: The tip of the pencil broke.

examples.japanese: {先端|せんたん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a product that uses cutting-edge technology.

examples.japanese: あの⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：03054_kenkyuusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{先端|せんたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}っている→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: Flowers are blooming at the tip of the branch.

examples.english: The tip of a needle is very thin.

examples.english: This university is known for its research in frontier science.

notes:
{先端|せんたん} has both physical (tip/point) and figurative (cutting edge) meanings.

PHYSICAL MEANING:
- The pointed end of objects (pencils, needles, branches)
- The outermost part of something

FIGURATIVE MEANING:
- {先端|せんたん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: cutting-edge technology
- {最|さい}{先端|せんたん}: the very forefront
- {先端|せんたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to be at the cutting edge

COMPOUNDS:
- {先端|せんたん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: advanced technology
- {先端|せんたん}⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧: frontier science
- {先端|せんたん}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧: high-tech industry
- {最|さい}{先端|せんたん}: state-of-the-art, cutting edge
